notes.title: Demo Update: Herd Mode + More Animals!
notes.notes:
New Mode:
-Herdmode Preview Added

Welcome to Herd Mode, where you can recruit new members and assemble a massive army of animals! be careful though, anyone who gets left behind is gone forever! 

New Options: 
[ ] Randomize Animals - Increase the challenge by randomizing all of the animals in the herd, from very fast horses to very slow chickens!
[ ] Randomize Starting Positions - Increase the challenge by randomizing the starting positions of the herd
[ ] Save Them all - this is a very difficult setting that only allows you to complete levels when every herd member survives!

New Animals:
-Horse Added
-Bull Added
-Buffalo Added
-Chicken Added

Changes: 
-Fire Now lingers and can be used more effectively. 


Various bug fixes: 

-Fences werent working properly
-fire was pushing animals around
-sounds settings were not saving properly
-some sounds were not respecting sound settings
-other random fixes
